title: Poplet - Simple Fidget RPG!
author: Upbeat_Ingenuity_745
selftext:
Game Title: Poplet!

Playable Link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.poplet.mobile

Platform: Android 

Description: Set out to make a simple bubble popping game and ended up making a casual fidget RPG. 

Weekly item hunts. Weekly mini games. Weekly community raid bosses.

Very happy how the game is growing and coming along.

Its very much free to play, and dont even need to dive into the rpg elements to enjoy it if fidget bubbles are your thing lol.

comments.author: ds1841
comments.body: How was the testing process to get into Playstore?I have an app to put on Playstore but didn't go thru the testing phase with real people yet

replies.author: Upbeat_Ingenuity_745
replies.body:
Use any and I mean any route necessary to get the testers required and keep shooting for more than what is required because testers fall off. 

Do tests for tests here on reddit. 

Download test for test apps like appdadz and peerplay. (Not an ad for them just the ones I used)
